svg.text: Concepts for review — pick a direction (or tell me what you like in each).
The reference: soft body, shackle lifted
Shackle swung open on its hinge: the most
Eyes look up at the open side: curious
A wink: playful, in on the joke
Small shackle on the shoulder: more
Keyhole eyes: the lock is the face
Max mass, small eyes: strongest as an app
